Then the equilibrium residual is exactly zero; J_ii=z_i S_ii-2R_i-beta_i z_i^3, J_ij=z_i S_ij. Gershgorin right edges all strictly less than -gamma. Upper Dini derivative of max abundance satisfies D+M<=M(R+LM+UM^2-BM^3), yielding a uniform absorbing cube, global continuation, and orthant invariance. The decoupled r=-1,S=0,z=1 case forces a positive Jacobian entry if only one own-density monomial is added to a given species, proving exactly 2n support in this intervention class. verify.py passed 1,400 exact-rational examples; examples are not substituted for analytic proof.

value.rationale: The primary 2026 result establishes possibility via unconstrained multi-species higher-order terms. This resolves whether arbitrary pairwise ecological obstructions can instead be overcome by exclusively within-species density dependence, with an explicit negative self-cubic carrying-bound term and positive self-quadratic term. It gives any target abundance and decay margin with a common absorbing box, and the exact minimal 2n feedback support within the ecologically meaningful diagonal degree-two/three family. Standard stability tools are distinguished from the new quantified sparse realization.
